name: PulseMCP
tagline: Hand-reviewed directory and news hub for the Model Context Protocol.
description: PulseMCP is a discovery hub for the Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem — a daily-updated, hand-reviewed directory of thousands of MCP servers and clients, validated by live handshake and scored on reliability. Alongside the directory it publishes tutorials, a use-case showcase, an API for programmatic access, and 'The Agentic Loop' newsletter. It is a free resource for finding and tracking MCP integrations.
insight: Run by Tadas Antanavicius, a member of the official MCP Steering Committee; its hand-reviewed directory tracks 18,000+ servers.

modelSupport.notes: A directory and news resource for MCP servers and clients — no model of its own.

edge: The largest hand-reviewed MCP directory — servers checked by live handshake and reliability-scored rather than auto-scraped — plus a public API.
pros: Tracks both MCP servers and clients
Run by an MCP Steering Committee member
cons: A directory/resource, not a tool you run
Does not host the servers itself
